messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 11):
"""
The said policy should enable empanelment of all categories of hospitals considering the affordability of different segments of population b. for every situation of treatment including domiciliary hospitalization, outpatient treatment (OPD), Day Care and Homecare treatment; (3) Proposal Forms/ Customer Information Sheet (CIS) a. Design the proposal forms in simple language and may also provide the proposal form and policy document in the scheduled languages. b. Disseminate information about the products to the prospects and policyholders in a transparent manner. Insurers shall mandatorily forward CIS in the specified format and obtain acknowledgement of the policyholder. (4) Claims Handling and Settlement process: a. Have in place well defined claims handling, claim settlement procedures, turnaround times (TATs) for settlement of claims and policy servicing. b. Constitute a Claims Review Committee (CRC):
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must insurers do regarding proposal forms and customer information sheets?","answer":"Insurers must design proposal forms in simple language, provide them in scheduled languages, disseminate product information transparently, forward the CIS in the specified format, and obtain acknowledgement from the policyholder.","facts":["Design the proposal forms in simple language","may also provide the proposal form and policy document in the scheduled languages","Disseminate information about the products to the prospects and policyholders in a transparent manner","Insurers shall mandatorily forward CIS in the specified format and obtain acknowledgement of the policyholder"]},{"question":"What are the requirements for claims handling and settlement processes?","answer":"Insurers must have well‑defined claims handling and settlement procedures, set turnaround times for settlement and policy servicing, and constitute a Claims Review Committee.","facts":["Have in place well defined claims handling, claim settlement procedures, turnaround times (TATs) for settlement of claims and policy servicing","Constitute a Claims Review Committee (CRC)"]}]}
